signature: SUBROUTINE DORMHR( SIDE, TRANS, M, N, ILO, IHI, A, LDA, TAU, C,

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Right.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q;
-   `= 'T'`: Transpose, apply $Q^T$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` must have the same values as in the previous call of DGEHRD. Q is equal to the unit matrix except in the submatrix Q(ilo+1:ihi,ilo+1:ihi). If `SIDE = 'L'`, then $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \mathrm{IHI} \le M$, if $M > 0$, and `ILO = 1` and `IHI = 0`, if $M = 0$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, then $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \mathrm{IHI} \le N$, if $N > 0$, and `ILO = 1` and `IHI = 0`, if $N = 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: (`LDA`,N) if `SIDE = 'R'` The vectors which define the elementary reflectors, as returned by DGEHRD.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$ if `SIDE = 'L'`; $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$ if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: (N-1) if `SIDE = 'R'` `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i), as returned by DGEHRD.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^T \, C$ or $C \, Q^T$ or $C \, Q$.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M)$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N \, \mathrm{NB}$ if `SIDE = 'L'`, and $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge M \, \mathrm{NB}$ if `SIDE = 'R'`, where NB is the optimal blocksize.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.js: ilo < 1 || ilo > max( 1, side === 'left' ? M : N )
ihi < min( ilo, side === 'left' ? M : N ) || ihi > (side === 'left' ? M : N)
